methodology.Volume: Everything staked on the up and down sides of every five-minute round, across the BNB, BTC and ETH price markets.
methodology.NotionalVolume: The size of each round's pot, which is what gets paid out when the round settles. Both sides stake into the same pot, so this matches the amount staked.
methodology.Fees: 3% of each round's total pot, counting both the winning and the losing stakes, taken when the round settles. When a round ends with nobody to pay out - the price finishes exactly where it started, or every bet was on the losing side — the whole pot goes to the treasury instead.
